QuestInfo.name: Signs of Their Revival
QuestInfo.0: There have been subtle signs that indicate the revival of the Arans. Talk to Cassandra for details.
QuestInfo.1: Ice Shards from the ice the Arans were sealed in have been found near town. Where are those Ice Shards?
QuestInfo.2: The Aran Memory Fragments...How long will it take for you to collect all 12?

0.0: Yes, there have been indications everywhere that have foreshadowed their revival. You should know what those signs are in order to find their Memory Fragments.

yes.0: According to what my Crystal Ball has shown me, the ice in which the heroes were sealed has started to crack as the curse weakens.
yes.1: You'll be able to find the Ice Shards near town. That would definitely help you find their Memory Fragments.

no.0: You mean you're ready to give up on finding the Aran Memory Fragments?

npc.0: If you spot an Ice Shard while passing by the Hunting Ground, don't just ignore it!
